title: Soap, Buckets, and Sunlight  (肥皂、水桶和阳光)

segments.t: 到了周日下午，汉娜、迦勒和欧文在九号房卷起袖子，准备了两个装满温热肥皂水的水桶和干净的棉布。首先来听听整段场景。
Take the lower panes, Hannah; Caleb and I can reach the top arch from the ladder.
Dip the sponge in warm water with a drop of vinegar, zero streaks on old glass!
Whoa, look at that first square I wiped! Blue sky and green leaves!
Remember when mom made us wash the kitchen windows every spring, Caleb?
You always splashed water on my shirt and blamed the wind!
Careful up there, you two. Keep the soapy water in the bucket!
Look through the clean glass now: you can see the whole courtyard lantern line!
When we open the outside shutters tomorrow, sunlight will pour across all four tables.
Wait, Caleb, didn't you say your train home leaves tonight at seven?
I called my studio partner and moved my ticket to Saturday morning.
Really?! You are staying in Portland until Friday's opening night?!
Nothing could pull me away before Room Nine opens!
现在我们来看看场景中的每一个句子。
Take the lower panes, Hannah; Caleb and I can reach the top arch from the ladder.
‘汉娜，你负责下面的玻璃；迦勒和我从梯子上能够到上面的拱形窗。’大窗户里的每一块独立的玻璃片叫做
the lower panes,
将 lower 与 top arch 相对比。
Dip the sponge in warm water with a drop of vinegar, zero streaks on old glass!
‘把海绵浸入加了一滴醋的温水中：在旧玻璃上绝对不会留痕！’将某物短暂浸入液体中然后拿出来用 dip 表示：
Dip the sponge
streaks 指的是肥皂没干透时留下的条纹或污迹。
Whoa, look at that first square I wiped! Blue sky and green leaves!
‘哇，看看我擦的第一块玻璃！蓝天绿叶！’用布或海绵擦拭表面以去除污垢用 wipe 表示：
first square I wiped!
在 square 和 I 之间省略了关系代词。
Remember when mom made us wash the kitchen windows every spring, Caleb?
‘迦勒，你还记得每年春天妈妈让我们洗厨房窗户的时候吗？’当有人强迫或让我们做家务时，make 后面跟着人和不带 to 的动词原形：
made us wash
非常利落且直接。
You always splashed water on my shirt and blamed the wind!
‘你总是把水溅到我的衬衫上，还怪风！’把责任推给某人或某事，在 blame 后面不需要加任何介词：
blamed the wind!
在这里结合了 splashed 的生动发音。
Careful up there, you two. Keep the soapy water in the bucket!
‘上面小心点，你们俩。把肥皂水留在水桶里！’要自信地同时称呼两个人，只需在 you 后面加上数字：
you two.
soapy 在 soap 后面加上 -y，意思是‘肥皂的，沾满肥皂沫的’。
Look through the clean glass now: you can see the whole courtyard lantern line!
‘现在透过干净的玻璃看看：能看到院子里的一整排灯笼！’透过窗户或透明玻璃看，需要用介词 through：
Look through the clean glass
这与 look at 不同，look at 是把视线停留在表面上。
When we open the outside shutters tomorrow, sunlight will pour across all four tables.
‘当我们明天打开外面的百叶窗时，阳光会倾泻在四张桌子上。’pour 这个动词，本来用于倒液体或倾盆大雨，在这里和光线结合，创造了一个美丽的画面：
sunlight will pour across
光线淹没了整个房间。
Wait, Caleb, didn't you say your train home leaves tonight at seven?
‘等等，迦勒，你不是说你回家的火车今晚七点开吗？’对于火车、飞机或公共汽车的固定时刻表，使用现在时：
your train home leaves
home 直接跟在 train 后面，不需要介词。
I called my studio partner and moved my ticket to Saturday morning.
‘我给工作室的合伙人打了电话，把我的票改到了周六早上。’把车票或预订改到另一个日期，用 move 表达非常实用：
moved my ticket to Saturday
就像之前检查的日期一样。
Really?! You are staying in Portland until Friday's opening night?!
‘真的吗！？你要在波特兰待到周五的开幕之夜！？’已经决定好的未来几天个人计划，用现在进行时听起来非常自然：
You are staying
opening night 是首演或开幕的夜晚。
Nothing could pull me away before Room Nine opens!
‘在九号房开放之前，没有什么能把我从这里拽走！’要表示没有什么能把我们从一个地方拉走，结合使用 pull 和 away：
pull me away
充满热情地结束了这一场景。让我们把整个场景连起来再听一遍。
Take the lower panes, Hannah; Caleb and I can reach the top arch from the ladder.
Dip the sponge in warm water with a drop of vinegar, zero streaks on old glass!
Whoa, look at that first square I wiped! Blue sky and green leaves!
Remember when mom made us wash the kitchen windows every spring, Caleb?
You always splashed water on my shirt and blamed the wind!
Careful up there, you two. Keep the soapy water in the bucket!
Look through the clean glass now: you can see the whole courtyard lantern line!
When we open the outside shutters tomorrow, sunlight will pour across all four tables.
Wait, Caleb, didn't you say your train home leaves tonight at seven?
I called my studio partner and moved my ticket to Saturday morning.
Really?! You are staying in Portland until Friday's opening night?!
Nothing could pull me away before Room Nine opens!
高大的拱形窗终于让院子里的绿意透了进来，而迦勒则把他的逗留时间延长到了开幕之夜！我们马上在外面百叶窗前见。
See you later!
